title: SignatureAbility
description: F-100 M12 (ruling f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-38, a sibling of force-power.schema.json; f100-m12-build-card step 3/5): one career's signature ability — its nodes (`abilities{}`, the base and every upgrade, in the Force-power ability's own row grammar), the purchase tree, the careers it belongs to and the bottom-row columns it attaches under. Written by ONE applier (scripts/canonical/apply_signature_abilities.py) from its committed instrument input. Nothing is charged in M12 (R-M12C-36, D-150): costs are shown with their `cost_status`.
$comment: R-M12C-38's fields and no others: `import_aliases` is NOT adopted (ERRATUM on R-M12C-19 (b)); OggDude's own spellings live in `fills[].note` (provenance), never as a field. The owned shape is the sheet's, not this record's: sheet.signatureAbilities [{id, tree, owned: ['row-col', …]}] (R-M12C-39).

_source_key.description: OggDude Key (e.g. 'UNMATCHEDTRADECRAFT'): the import's match key, as every registry's.

name.description: The PRINTED name, read on its page (R-M12C-19 (b), R-M12C-30): 'Unmatched Negotiation', not OggDude's 'Unmatched Negotiations'.

careers.description: Career ids that may take it (V1: 'A character can only acquire a signature ability from his career', all 19 career books).

columns.description: OggDude MatchingNodes' active nodes, 1-based: the bottom-row talent columns of the attached tree the owner must hold (V3).

wording.description: F-100 M12 (f100-m12-build-card R-M12B-7, R-M12B-11, R-M12B-26/-28): how the description stands. `verified` = Jason's bound read of the box (D-159, Docs/rulings/f100-m12-build-card.text-reads.json; the applier refuses drift from it); `mechanical:<rule>[+<rule>…]` = fixed by the text sweep's named rules (scripts/f100_m12_text_sweep.py), never `verified`; `residual` = text no rule settles, awaiting Jason's page check. ABSENT = the census's read of the printed page carried no hit.

activation_base.description: R-M12B-25: the BASE node only (validator), beside use_cost: the activation's own terms, each set only where the base box's printed words state it, under the record's cite. The fold returns base + Σ deltas (clamped at a `floor`), or the `*_set` value; a mod on a term the base does not state folds as the modification alone, `base: unstated`. "Until the end of the encounter" and other non-round durations are not a `duration_rounds`: they stay in the words (QUALITATIVE).

use_cost.description: The BASE node only (validator): the activation's printed price, e.g. {destiny: 2} (SV3, R-M12C-16), shown and never charged.

except.description: the quality ids the activation may NOT add (Unmatched Ingenuity: breach, concussive); any other vocabulary quality may be picked.

item.description: a weapon or item the character is holding or operating, picked at the activation (session state, never saved).

quality_grant.description: F-100 M12 QG1 (f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-26/-95; gate table §5): the BASE node only (validator): the activation adds ONE quality, picked then, to a held item for the activation's duration (`activation_base.duration_rounds`). OFFERED at the activation, never applied by itself and never saved. The base's further spends ([TR]: one more quality; [AD]: +1 rating) stay in the words.

quality_grant_allow.description: F-100 M12 QG1: an UPGRADE node only (validator): owned, these qualities leave the base's `except` list (Unmatched Ingenuity's Quality (Breach) and Quality (Concussive) boxes, Fully Operational p.35).

activation_mods.description: An UPGRADE node only (validator): its change to the owned ability's activation terms (R-M12C-97 as corrected by R-M12C-105, R-M12B-6), folded over the base and shown at the activation, never charged. A `*_set` op appears at most once per (ability, op), counted per BOX; a `*_delta` sums over the boxes bought (SV2's count).

activation_check.description: The base ability's activation check, verbatim from its description. R-AAC-27 (b), ruling argo-a1-export-fields D3: derived from the description by scripts/canonical/apply_text_encodings.py; the app reads it, else today's parse (D4).

abilities.description: The ability's nodes, keyed by node id (OggDude's node Key, lower-case): the base (the tree's row 0) and every upgrade. Rows are the Force-power ability's own grammar (no new row grammar, R-M12C-38); their `words`/`condition` spans index the NODE's own description.

tree.description: Purchase grid, top row first (row 0 = the base, one cell of span 4). V5: an upgrade needs the base; V6: each upgrade links to the base or an owned cell.

ability.description: Key into this record's abilities map (validator).

cost_status.description: R-M12C-36 as amended by f100-surfacing-creator-concept ADDENDUM 10 (R-SCD-1): `verified` where every box of the tree was read against the printed page — by a human (DECISIONS D-229 @ 3adb14d96 for 32 trees) or by the census's complete text-layer read (AGREES, 6 trees); the record's `cost_read` says whose; `inferred` otherwise (B-1243).

row.description: A placement fill is never row 0 (the base is OggDude's own); a WORDS fill (`replaces` = the node itself: R-M12B-23, R-M12B-30) may sit on the base.

replaces.description: The node id OggDude's data puts in that cell.

note.description: Provenance: what the OggDude data holds and why the page wins (R-RRD-1).

fills.description: R-M12C-19 (c): a named fill where OggDude's tree disagrees with the printed page — never an edit to the OggDude copy. The tree already carries the fill; this records it. A WORDS fill (`replaces` = the cell's own node; R-M12B-23, R-M12B-30, D-159) records where the shipped words differ from what the census captured: the other printing quoted, a wrong capture, or the page the words were read on — one per cell of the node.

cite.description: F-100 M12 (f100-m12-build-card ADDENDUM 37, R-M12B-125; D-M12E2 (a)): the record's printing — {book: its sources[0], page: OggDude's Source Page, the PRINTED page}, census-read (sig-nodes `printed_page_data`) and written by apply_signature_abilities.py. Optional here, so a user record without one validates; the SHIPPED registry requires it (validate_registries L1cb.sig). The editor prints it as "· P. n".

cost_read.description: F-100 (ruling f100-surfacing-creator-concept ADDENDUM 10, R-SCD-2): whose complete read of the printed page the tree's `verified` cells rest on. `jason` = DECISIONS D-229 @ 3adb14d96, `strip` its #n on the inspection sheet (Docs/briefs/f100-sig-cost-pages.json @ 057c7dfb0; the reads are Docs/rulings/f100-surfacing-creator-concept.cost-reads.json); `census` = the attach census's complete text-layer read (AGREES, Docs/briefs/f100-m12-attach.json). Optional here (a user record validates without it); required on the shipped registry (validate_registries L1cb.sig).

tree_page.description: F-100 (ruling f100-surfacing-creator-concept ADDENDUM 10, R-SCD-3): the PRINTED page the purchase grid sits on (the attach census's `printed`). `cite.page` stays the record's printing; four shipped trees differ (diplomaticsol 38/39, unins 40/41, rousor 38/39, unmatchedauth 40/41). Optional here; required on the shipped registry (validate_registries L1cb.sig).

sig_pool_mod.description: F-100 M12 (R-M12C-14/15/20): a signature node's dice row — item-common's pool_mod_entry as a Force-power upgrade's (power_row_refusals: no per_rank, no pick); anchored on the ability's activation check (SV1) or the owner's career skills (SV5) or a skill; `count_of` reads SV2's boxes bought only.

floor.description: R-M12B-21: a `*_delta` op only (refused on a `*_set` op, here and by the validator): the fold clamps the summed result at it. First user: Unmatched Authority's Endurance, "to a minimum of 1". The schema's existing `floor` idiom (a talent's difficulty floor, R-M8K-29).

activation_mod.description: R-M12C-97 / R-M12C-105 (R-M12B-6): one PLAIN change to the owned ability's activation terms. destiny_cost_set 0..2 (0 = no Destiny cost, e.g. Prophecy; the base's use_cost keeps minimum 1); uses_per_session_delta +1 per box; range_set a band of ranges.vocab.json's personal scale; range_delta +1 band per box, capped at the last band; duration_delta in the base's own unit; strain_cost_delta; target_silhouette_delta; activation_add action | maneuver. A QUALITATIVE change stays TOLD.
